sentences.text:
The present petitioner who has been arrayed an as accused in CR Case No.2487/2019 under Sections 26(1)(2)(i) read with Section 59 of the Food and Safety Page No.# 2/2 and Standard Act,
2006, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati has challenged the entire proceeding on the ground that the petitioner has been wrongly arrayed as an accused in the aforesaid complaint case whereas the company itself has not arrayed him as an accused in the said case.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is contended that the petitioner is one of the Director of the company and his role is also not specifically mentioned in the complaint petition.
Considered the submission made before this Court and perused the documents annexed.
The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has also conceded that question of law is to be appreciated in the matter in hand.
As the respondent No.2 is represented by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, so no separate notice be issued against him.
Let extra copies be furnished to the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
Call for the scanned copy of the LCR.
Let the matter be listed on 29.10.2019.
Till then, further proceeding of CR Case No.2487/2019 as aforesaid is hereby stayed.
